answer: Reaching the river of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. A zenith of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ferrous of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
